name: Spirit Form
description: Your physical form can shift between corporeal and incorporeal. Mark a Stress to transition into and out of your Spirit Form. While in Spirit Form, you can move through solid objects, are immune to physical damage, and take double magic damage. You can spend 2 Hope to attack or physically interact with the material world.
